response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with a strong background in full-stack development, testing frameworks, and high-performance microservices. However, the resume lacks evidence of building enterprise-scale growth, experimentation, or telemetry platforms, which are the core focus of this Principal-level role.
strengths: Over 15 years of software engineering experience across a diverse set of languages (TypeScript, Node.js, C++, Java) and distributed systems.
Proven track record of building high-performance microservices, such as handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby.
Demonstrated leadership in engineering quality, having created testing frameworks and championed software craftsmanship.
concerns: No visible experience designing and building enterprise-scale experimentation frameworks, feature-flagging systems, or measurement platforms.
Lacks demonstrated background in growth engineering, telemetry foundations, or statistical experimental data analysis.
While having Staff-level experience, the scope of cross-team architectural leadership in a large enterprise environment may fall short of IC6 expectations.
